description:
Property Reference: 2965475.

Off Oxford Road, Rare 1Gbps SuperFast Wifi 🏂

5 mins walk directly to the University of Manchester and Hospitals.  Close to the City Centre.

 The bus stop is just 1 minute walk away. Lots of buses run at all times, 24/7. Bus 147 to all university departments, free for University of Manchester and MMU

 You can enjoy close proximity to a large number of supermarkets, restaurants, pubs, bars, cafés, shops, swimming pools and sports centres! Big Tesco, large Lidl, Worldwide Supermarket, Superdrug, gym, beautiful Whitworth Park, Pound Shop, post office, etc. are all just about 1 minute walk away.

 The house is also in a leafy conservation area, ensuring a pleasant and fairly quiet atmosphere in which to live. It is in excellent modern condition. The studio is brand new, with your own shower room and kitchen, superfast internet, an advanced Beko Bluetooth washer dryer, fridge freezer, microwave oven, safe and super fast heating induction hob. You do not need to share any facilities with anyone. You can fully enjoy your own space and time without any interference or stress.

 A super popular and super convenient location, making this a rare opportunity to live in such a highly desirable place.

 No guarantor required.  University students and professionals only.

 

 Please🌻 briefly respond to the following questions to help us process your application in your best interest:

 (1). Rent start and end date?

 (2). What do you do in Manchester? 

 (3). Studio? Ensuite? Shared bathroom and kitchen ? 

 (4). Room size: Big, Small, Medium, or Doesn't matter?

 (5). Bed preference: Single, Double, Bunk bed, or Doesn't matter?

 (6). Upper rent limit?

 (7). Your WhatsApp number for viewings, photos and videos.

 

 Many thanks for interest.

 

Summary & Exclusions:
- Rent Amount: £1,000.00 per month (£230.77 per week)
- Deposit / Bond: £1,153.84
- 1 Bedrooms
- 1 Bathrooms
- Property comes furnished
- Available to move in from 28 August 2026
- Maximum number of tenants is 1
- Students welcome to enquire
- No Smokers
- Bills Included
- Property has parking
- Property has garden access
- EPC Rating: D

  If calling, please quote reference: 2965475  

Fees:
You will not be charged any admin fees.

 ** Contact today to book a viewing and have the landlord show you round! ** 
Request Details form responded to 24/7, with phone bookings available 9am-9pm, 7 days a week.
